NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author squashed the work into one commit (same +19/-2 in the same 2 files) and commented "Ready for review!". The PR description doesn't yet follow the guide that was linked.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | The self-review checklist isn't the one from the PR template, and the description has stray backslashes around `command` and `text`. |
| ❌  | The PR doesn't mention the open PR #38098 for the same issue, and the issue is claimed by @pranjal499. #38902 was closed for the same gap. |
| ⚠️  | Testing is described only as "manually tested", with no concrete steps or results. |
| ✅  | CI passes, and the fix is now a single commit with a clear message. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the description and explain how this PR relates to #38098 and the issue's current assignee.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Before this can be reviewed, please fill in the [PR template](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) properly (including its self-review checklist), and explain how this PR relates to the open #38098 and the issue's current assignee, per our [guide on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also describe the manual testing you did and what you saw.
```
